305-4613-4687.easyPrerequisites:
Gilder Bairn is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Llanowar Tribe has a +1/+1 counter on it.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-1417-2464-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1417-2464-3249--52.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-1417-2464-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Bridge from Below triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2060-3574-4222-7803.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Mikaeus.
Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
2060-3574-4222-7803.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-3574-4222-7803.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1446-7009-7715.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1446-7009-7715.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

3767-3918-4306-7223.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least 3.
3767-3918-4306-7223.description:
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

338-4365-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-4365-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

requires.battlefieldCardState: without a finality counter on it

4053-6798-7134--145.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a Villain without a finality counter on it.
When the Villain dies, Thunderbolts Conspiracy triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

3750-5471-7024-7131.easyPrerequisites: Braid of Fire has an age counter on it, or Obeka's power is 3 or greater.
3750-5471-7024-7131.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Obeka. Obeka triggers, causing you to get that many upkeep steps after this one.
Move to your first extra upkeep. At the beginning of that upkeep, Braid of Fire triggers, putting an age counter on it and adding {R} for each age counter on it.
Repeat step 2 for each other upkeep step.
During your postcombat main phase, activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

requires.n: Land with Cycling Cost that can be paid using one colored mana

65-2546-2628-6437--38.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {0} due to Fluctuator and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Surly Badgersaur trigger.
Resolve Surly Badgersaur's ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding (1).
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Pothole Mole.
When Pothole Mole enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return the cycled land from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
65-2546-2628-6437--38.notes: Since you can draw your entire library, discarding down to maximum hand size at end of turn will trigger Surly Badgersaur's abilities many times.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

284-6798-6972--112.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Angel of Invention.
When Angel of Invention dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Angel of Invention enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
284-6798-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Angel of Invention's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

2793-4659-5089-6459.description:
If Karn has exactly one loyalty counter on it, activate its first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus will be exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Aetheric Amplifier by paying {4} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Karn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat from step 2.

141-1269-3967.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1269-3967.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Exhume.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1492-2866-4986-5231.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-2866-4986-5231.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1385-2173-3944-5220.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1315-2653-5721-6883.easyPrerequisites: There are at least six land cards between your graveyard and the battlefield under your control, one of which must be a Swamp.
1315-2653-5721-6883.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing any land, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least six land cards in your graveyard, with one of those cards being a Swamp.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Nissa triggers that many times, adding {B/G} for each trigger.
Activate Strands of Night by paying {B}{B} and 2 life and sacrificing a Swamp, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

4050-4375-5400.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Synth Infiltrator.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

338-2541-4869.notablePrerequisites:
Glint-Horn Buccaneer has lifelink.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
338-2541-4869.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Repeat from step 2.

856-2279-5776-6797.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

813-1922-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Walk the Aeons and Blur.
813-1922-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons and Blur from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

5437-5742-5743-6441.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-2438-4558-4863.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least eleven tapped lands.
2091-2438-4558-4863.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Revolutionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Revolutionist by paying its mana cost.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Revolutionist.
Repeat.

3951-5147-5703-5744.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
3951-5147-5703-5744.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

440-1339-2034-5789.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-2034-5789.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

4377-4477-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons and Greenwarden of Murasa each turn.
4377-4477-6122.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa by paying its mana cost.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Axonil, Deepest Might // Temple of Power

2511-2868-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
2511-2868-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Axonil that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Axonil that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.

2438-2896-5145.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Necromancy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Necromancy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Necromancy to it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2232-4050-4690.manaNeeded: {4}{R}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2232-4050-4690.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six basic lands.
2232-4050-4690.description:
Cast Phylath either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{R}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Phylath enters the battlefield, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Phylath trigger, creating at least six 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
When the Plants enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Phylath to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining triggers, choosing not to return anything to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six Plants, adding {4}{R}{G}.
Repeat.
If you control seven or more basic lands, this combo nets infinite Plant tokens and infinite colored mana.

2026-2404-2816.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Voyaging Satyr.
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four creatures.
2026-2404-2816.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2660-5065.notablePrerequisites: Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to any opponent.
2660-5065.description:
Activate Helm of Obedience by paying {1} and tapping, causing target player enchanted with Wheel of Sun and Moon to mill a card until a creature card is put into their graveyard this way.
Any cards put into the graveyard by Helm of Obedience is put onto the bottom of that player's library.
